subject: Pricing & route mix recap — multi-model expansion
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Sullivan <sam.sullivan@nimbushealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing & route mix recap — multi-model expansion

Hi Sam / Procurement team,

Thanks again for the call this morning — really appreciated the candid rundown on usage patterns and where Nimbus wants to head over the next 6–12 months. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary of what we learned
- Current production usage: ~15M tokens / month (encoder + chat mixes).
- Growth expectation: ~40M tokens / month within 6 months if the new triage pipeline and patient-summary route are live.
- Route mix: 60% faster embeddings/chat base models, 30% higher-quality summarization (longer context), 10% occasional finetune-variant for clinical notes.
- Procurement timeline: you indicated a target PO in mid-November; procurement asked for a short SOW and preliminary pricing grid to review with finance.

Pricing / unit economics asks from your side
- You asked for a target blended unit price to compare vendors (target ~$300 / 1M tokens as a starting point).
- You also asked about a volume band structure and an approach to blended rates when you add new routes/models.

What we will deliver (next steps)
1) Redwood will send a preliminary blended pricing grid by EOD Thu (10/08) showing 3 scenarios: current run rate (15M), 6-mo growth (40M), and long-term steady-state (75M). Grid will include per-route $/1M token assumptions and an example blended monthly cost. (Action: Aditya + Priya)
2) We will include a short SOW template that maps to your procurement checklist and highlights data handling & VPC options. (Action: Priya)
3) Schedule a 30-min follow-up to walk the grid and sizing assumptions — we propose Fri 10/09 or Wed 10/14. Calendar links below.

Attachments: MAA-draft.pdf (redlines ok), ExamplePromptSet.xlsx (sample prompts & token estimates).

Open questions for procurement:
- Can you confirm the PO approval owner and any contract signoff SLAs we should expect?
- Any constrained budget bands we should prioritize in the proposal (e.g., maximum monthly commitment)?

If that all looks right I'll get the grid over to you tomorrow and loop in Solutions for an optional architecture call.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Sam Sullivan <sam.sullivan@nimbushealth.com>

Cc: Procurement <procurement@nimbushealth.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing & route mix recap — multi-model expansion

Thanks Priya — this looks correct and helpful. A few clarifications: 

- Confirmed: current ~15M tokens/mo (mix of embeddings + short chat).
- Expectation: ~40M tokens/mo in ~6 months after we enable the patient-summary route and batch ingestion.
- Procurement note: finance prefers to see a baseline blended price and an upper-bound option if we commit to the 75M band. Our target blended benchmark is around $300 / 1M tokens; our incumbent vendor is at ~$420 / 1M so we are primarily looking for ~25–30% unit cost savings at scale.

Procurement will need the SOW + preliminary pricing to put in front of the budget owners. We can target mid-November for PO but that depends on the final blended numbers and whether we can show predictable monthly spend.

Sam
Head of Infra & Data Products
Nimbus Health
sam.sullivan@nimbushealth.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Sullivan <sam.sullivan@nimbushealth.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-06T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing & route mix recap — multi-model expansion

Sam — appreciated the context. Quick note on the pricing approach we plan to include in the grid so procurement has options: 

Pricing scenarios we'll present
- Scenario A (Conservative): volume bands with step-up discounts at 25M / 50M / 100M tokens; standard per-route list pricing; expected blended target ~ $380 / 1M at 40M.
- Scenario B (Aggressive): commitment-based blended tiers with a deeper discount if you commit to a 12-mo reserved volume (example blended ~$290 / 1M at 40M).
- Scenario C (Pay-as-you-go + route routing): lower base price on the faster routes, higher on long-context summarization; we show an illustrative blended result that hits Sam's $300 benchmark for specific route mixes.

We'll also include an alternate 'route-add band' that allows adding a new high-cost model with a transitional blended uplift for the first 30 days, then automatic integration into the band at the next billing period — that accommodates trials of finetune/experimental models without blowing the blended economics.

Attaching prelim-pricing-grid.csv for internal: it's a working file; Priya / Marissa — warn me if any assumptions look aggressive and I'll adjust before we send externally.

Aditya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

Priya / Sam,

Thanks — procurement here. For our review we need:
- Short SOW that includes data residency, retention, and audit/logging controls.
- Preliminary pricing grid showing banded pricing and any minimum commitments.
- Standard security appendix (SOC 2 in progress is acceptable but call out the date).

Attached is a one-page doc listing our SOW requirements (Nimbus_SOW_Requirements.docx). If you can provide the SOW + pricing by Thu 10/08 we can start internal routing. Also please call out the estimated monthly invoice at the 40M band and the Delta vs incumbent.

Thanks all — we're on it. Final checklist and commitments from Redwood: 

- Deliverable: SOW draft + preliminary pricing grid (per-route and blended scenarios) by EOD Thu 10/08.
- Owner: Priya will own the SOW; Aditya will finalize the pricing grid with marissa's input on migration/cutover costs.
- Meeting: proposed 30-min review — Fri 10/09 10:00am PT. (Calendar: https://calendar.redwood.ai/meet/pricing-proposal-20261008)

Notes for the SOW: we'll call out options for VPC deployment vs hosted with private tenancy, and a proposed 90‑day transitional discount for any experimental model routes you trial. We'll also include the SOC 2 timeline and a redline-friendly MAA.

If procurement prefers a different review cadence let me know; otherwise we'll ship the draft tomorrow and include a short narrated spreadsheet that explains the blended math (assumptions per-route: tokens per call, avg sequence length, cache hit rate).

Best,
